blocks.html: The pse::Quat:: namespace contains a set of helper functions (helpers) designed for creating and initializing PseQuat quaternions based on Euler angles in the ZYX rotation order (Unreal Engine: Z - up, X - forward)

head: Signature
Return type
Description
rows: fromRadians(const float pitch, const float yaw, const float roll)
Computes and returns a PseQuat quaternion based on Euler angles (Pitch, Yaw, Roll) specified in radians
fromDegrees(const float pitch, const float yaw, const float roll)
Computes and returns a PseQuat quaternion based on Euler angles (Pitch, Yaw, Roll) specified in degrees
